learnings.text: · A `works.count`/`.list`-based deletion target can be actively growing under live automation** — before running a bulk delete filtered by count/list, snapshot the full matching id set into a manifest file first, then delete exactly that manifest. Don't re-derive "what to delete" from a live count/list call partway through, since a service-account workflow (or any other automation) can be creating new matching records faster than you can delete old ones, turning a one-time cleanup into a chase that never converges. Originated from a PDP-issue-subtype bulk delete where the count grew from 21,877 to 25,349 in ~15 minutes mid-task. This is a cross-cutting operational lesson, not tied to one API

· Customer and org identifiers are redacted in this public repo.** Real org ids appear as `devo/<ORG_ID>`, customer names as "a customer", and local workspace paths as `<workspace>/`. Never record a real org id, customer name or local path in a skill, reference or journal row (see `.claude/skills/capture-learnings`). Git history from before this date still contains the originals.

· Reference copies consolidated.** The duplicated reference files formerly under `skills/{1,2,3}-*/references/` now exist once, in `skills/8-devrev-api/references/` (same filenames). Older journal rows whose "Files updated" cell names a `skills/{1,2,3}-*/references/<file>` path mean that file in skill 8. The skill 1 and skill 2 copies (newer, live-verified) became the canonical `Custom_Objects_and_Links_API.md` and `Stages_States_and_StageDiagrams_API.md`.

Live regression P2-04: `schemas.custom.set` returned HTTP 400 `value_not_permitted` on `id_prefix=RGT639` — pattern `^[A-Z]{2,10}$` Custom-object `id_prefix` must be 2–10 **uppercase letters only** (no digits, no length beyond 10). Reference examples showed `LOAN` but never named the constraint

Live regression P2-04: `schemas.custom.get` response wraps the schema under key `fragment`, not `schema` (parser assumed the latter and returned nulls) Response wrapper for the get is `fragment`; for `.list` it's `result` (paginated). `.create/.set` returns `{id}`. There is no `schemas.custom.delete`. Existing fragments must be soft-deprecated (mechanism TBD) or ignored. Reference doc language "full replacement — always list all existing fields" is misleading.
